title: The Monsoon of Devil's Throat
author: Petra Amberdale
blurb: Elodie Winterbourne, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
